parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: hybrid: answer options are offered as buttons where a question has them; full: everything in conversation.

parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.description: Instructions for the interviewer.

parameters.name: greeting
parameters.description: What the interviewer opens with (adapted naturally).

parameters.name: farewell
parameters.description: The closing words; empty uses the platform's.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Interview language (e.g. "de"); empty follows the respondent.

parameters.name: max_follow_ups
parameters.description: Follow-up questions per survey question at most.

parameters.name: answer_quality_check
parameters.description: How a follow-up is decided: answer length, an AI check, or not at all.

parameters.name: acknowledgement_style
parameters.description: How the interviewer reacts to what was said.

parameters.name: question_overrides
parameters.description: Per survey question (by name): {"probing_mode": "probing"|"direct"|"skip", "acknowledgement_style": "neutral"|"reflective"}.

parameters.name: store_ai_summary
parameters.description: Keep the interviewer's summary of each open answer next to the answer.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The language model; "" uses the one of the AI feature "Interview".

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature; null leaves it to the provider. Sent only to models that take one.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Longest reply in tokens; 0 = no limit.

parameters.name: micro_narrative_enabled
parameters.description: Offer summaries of the interview at the end.

parameters.name: micro_narrative_options
parameters.description: How many summaries.

parameters.name: micro_narrative_max_revisions
parameters.description: How often new summaries may be asked for.

parameters.name: micro_narrative_prompt
parameters.description: Extra instructions for writing the summaries.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: The respondent's language (e.g. "de"); default: the survey's.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: How the interview proceeds: an open conversation, a list of questions, or a flow of states.

parameters.name: interviewDescription
parameters.description: What the interview is about (the brief the interviewer gets).

parameters.name: systemPrompt
parameters.description: How the interviewer behaves — added after the built-in rules.

parameters.name: openingMessage
parameters.description: A fixed first message; empty lets the interviewer write one.

parameters.name: closingMessage
parameters.description: A fixed last message; empty uses the platform's.

parameters.name: endCondition
parameters.description: Open conversation only: when the interview has what it needs.

parameters.name: maxTurns
parameters.description: Answers after which the interview ends.

parameters.name: maxCharsPerAnswer
parameters.description: Longest answer taken, in characters.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The language model; "" uses the one of the AI feature "Interview".

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature; null leaves it to the provider. Sent only to models that take one.

parameters.name: maxTokens
parameters.description: Longest reply in tokens; 0 = no limit.

parameters.name: interviewQuestions
parameters.description: List of questions mode: the questions, in order.

parameters.name: flowStates
parameters.description: Flow mode: the states (a question each) and where each goes otherwise.

parameters.name: flowTransitions
parameters.description: Flow mode: transitions — from a state, on a condition (text), to a state or "__end".

parameters.name: contextUsage
parameters.description: Which earlier answers the interviewer sees.

parameters.name: contextQuestions
parameters.description: With "selected": the names of the questions it sees.

parameters.name: contextInstructions
parameters.description: How the interviewer should use the earlier answers.

parameters.name: microNarrativeOptions
parameters.description: Summaries offered at the end; 0 = none.

parameters.name: microNarrativePrompt
parameters.description: Extra instructions for writing the summaries.

parameters.name: microNarrativeMaxRevisions
parameters.description: How often new summaries may be asked for.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: The respondent's language (e.g. "de"); default: the survey's.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Earlier answers of the respondent, by question name — what the interviewer may see of them follows contextUsage.
